excerpt: Wildlife Studios is a Brazilian mobile game developer behind Tennis Clash, Zooba and Sniper 3D, valued at about $3 billion in its 2020 Series B.
content:
Wildlife Studios is a mobile game company from Brazil. Crunchbase News reported that brothers Victor and Arthur Lazarte founded it in 2011, and that by 2020 it had launched more than 60 titles and passed 2 billion downloads. Its best-known games include Tennis Clash, the battle game Zooba, the shooter Sniper 3D and War Machines. In its newsroom Wildlife says Sniper 3D has reached 1 billion downloads in ten years, and it announces partnerships such as a Tennis Clash tie-in with the Australian Open and the International Tennis Federation's World Tennis eChampionship. Wildlife also runs a publishing arm for games from outside studios and lists job openings and an internship programme on its site.

Funding

In August 2020 Wildlife raised a $120 million Series B led by Vulcan Capital, with existing investor Human Capital participating. Reuters reported that the round valued the company at $3 billion; Crunchbase News described the valuation as nearly $3 billion and said the round took Wildlife's total funding to about $250 million. Before that, a round from Benchmark in late 2019 had made it a unicorn. At the time, CEO Victor Lazarte said the company planned to spend up to $200 million over two years to attract game designers, according to PocketGamer.biz.

Pricing

Wildlife does not publish a price list on its website. Its games are distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play, where each game's own listing shows its price and any in-app purchases.

Who it is for

For players, Wildlife makes casual and mid-core mobile games such as sports and shooting titles. For developers, its publishing team works with outside studios. For job seekers, its careers pages list openings and internships.

We have not reviewed Wildlife's games for this page. It is based on Wildlife's website and newsroom and on Reuters, Crunchbase News and PocketGamer.biz reporting.
